name: Neko
sourceEvidence: The archived POC's exact official source tarball was rehashed read-only; the clean build fetches the same URL and rejects a mismatch.
toolchain: Go1.27.3 native Linux CGO plus X11, GTK3 and GStreamer development libraries; the pinned module overlay requires Go1.26.0
patches: The exact module and checksum overlay in infrastructure/images/desktop-neko/upstream-modules replaces upstream go.mod and go.sum; upstream application source is unchanged.
note: This Docker image has a normal isolated container network when media is enabled. It does not include the separate loopback-only VZ POC patch or claim VZ support. Browser SDK bundle is a separate npm-lockfile input.
